verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs explicitly state 'VM-based isolation - Each sandbox runs in its own VM' and that the SDK 'enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments,' directly documenting a hard VM isolation boundary. No community evidence concretely contradicts this specific isolation claim. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the VM boundary (e.g. escape testing or third-party security audit), and more technical detail (hypervisor/microVM specifics like Firecracker/gVisor) beyond the brief docs statement
